messages:
claire: Customer wants a one-paragraph answer: for the 7-day POC can we ensure all inference compute, request/response logs and traces stay inside the EU? Also need full subprocessor list and a quick cost delta if we force eu-only routing. Kickoff Friday AM. cc @diego @priya :wave:
diego: Yes — we can run EU-only. For hosted add header X-Redwood-Region-Preference: eu and set X-Redwood-Fail-If-Unavailable: true to prevent silent fallbacks (requests will 503 if EU capacity full).
priya: Exporting subprocessor CSV now. Key EU subprocessors: EU CSP (eu-west-1), EU CDN (FR/DE/IE POPs), EU monitoring partner (aggregated metrics only). We do not forward full request/response payloads to third-party SaaS. I'll upload CSV to /legal and DM NDA link.
ian: Cost note: ad-hoc hosted eu-only routing usually increases per-token ~6-12% due to regional instance pricing and lower opportunistic routing. If they want fixed pricing provision a small reserved pool for the POC (1-2 GPUs) and we can quote a short-term commit.
claire: They also asked about telemetry replication — do any metrics get copied outside EU by default? Need a yes/no sentence.
priya: One-liner: by default some aggregated analytics are replicated for platform ops, BUT we can disable cross-border telemetry replication for enterprise POCs via contract.
legal-bot: Automated: NDA-POC-1785554321.pdf uploaded to /legal/attachments/POC-1785554321. Tag with customer name to auto-generate SOW stub.
infra-bot: Provisioning: eu-poc namespace requested by claire scheduled 2026-02-12T08:15Z. ETA ~11m.
claire: Perfect. I'll send the CSV + one-line infosec bullets + two SOW options (hosted eu-bias vs reserved pool) to the customer. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
